fields.title: Solar Water Pumps for Aswan Farmers
fields.description: Empowering local farmers in Aswan by installing sustainable solar-powered water pumps to reduce irrigation costs, combat fuel shortages, and increase crop yields year-round.
fields.story:
Agriculture is the lifeblood of Aswan's local economy, but traditional diesel-powered water pumps are increasingly expensive and environmentally harmful. Due to high fuel prices and frequent maintenance issues, many small-scale farmers struggle to irrigate their lands efficiently, leading to reduced crop yields and severe financial distress.

This project aims to install high-efficiency solar water systems for vulnerable farming communities in Aswan. By harnessing Egypt's abundant solar energy, farmers will gain reliable, zero-emission irrigation solutions. This green transition will dramatically cut operational costs, protect the environment, and secure a sustainable livelihood for dozens of families who depend entirely on agriculture.

Support our campaign today to bring clean energy, lower expenses, and long-term agricultural resilience to the heart of Aswan!

fields.title: Code Like a Girl - Alexandria
fields.description: A specialized bootcamp and mentoring initiative designed to equip young girls and women in Alexandria with modern programming, web development, and digital literacy skills to bridge the gender gap in tech.
fields.story:
Despite the booming tech industry, women remain significantly underrepresented in software engineering, tech leadership, and STEM fields across Egypt. In Alexandria, many talented young girls lack access to professional coding workshops, technical mentors, and the structured resources needed to kickstart a digital career.

"Code Like a Girl - Alexandria" is designed to change this narrative. We provide immersive, beginner-friendly coding bootcamps focusing on web development, Python, problem-solving, and modern digital tools. Beyond technical training, the program connects participants with experienced mentors and tech professionals who guide them through building real-world applications.

By supporting this campaign, you are investing in the future of aspiring female technologists, fostering gender equality, and driving innovation in Alexandria's tech ecosystem. Help us empower the next generation of women coders today!

fields.title: Mobile Clinics for Upper Egypt Villages
fields.description: Deploying fully equipped mobile medical clinics to remote villages in Upper Egypt to provide free healthcare checkups, essential treatments, and health awareness to underserved communities.
fields.story:
Access to quality healthcare remains a major challenge for families living in remote and underserved villages across Upper Egypt. Due to long distances to the nearest hospitals, lack of transportation, and financial constraints, many residents—especially the elderly, women, and children—go without essential medical checkups and vital treatments.

The "Mobile Clinics for Upper Egypt Villages" initiative bridges this healthcare gap directly. Our mobile units are fully equipped with modern medical tools, diagnostic equipment, and a dedicated team of professional doctors, nurses, and pharmacists. We travel directly to isolated rural areas to deliver free general consultations, chronic disease screenings, and necessary medications.

Your contribution will directly fund medical supplies, fuel, and staffing for these mobile units, bringing life-saving care and hope straight to the doorstep of those who need it most. Join us in making healthcare accessible for everyone!

fields.title: Tunis Village Pottery School
fields.description: Establishing a community pottery and handicrafts training school in Tunis Village, Fayoum, to preserve traditional Egyptian craftsmanship and empower local youth and artisans with sustainable income skills.
fields.story:
Tunis Village in Fayoum is globally renowned for its rich heritage of pottery and handmade crafts. However, traditional artisans face modern economic pressures, and younger generations are losing touch with this priceless cultural art form due to a lack of structured training facilities and marketing platforms.

The "Tunis Village Pottery School" project is dedicated to keeping this legacy alive by building a fully equipped local training center. Here, master artisans will teach traditional pottery-making, glazing, and modern design techniques to local youth and women. The school will provide hands-on workshops, tools, and a platform to exhibit and sell their crafts to visitors.

Your support will help fund kiln equipment, raw materials, and workspace maintenance, ensuring that Tunis Village remains a vibrant hub of art, heritage, and sustainable community development. Donate today to preserve Egypt’s timeless craftsmanship!

fields.title: Restore the Mashrabiya of Historic Cairo
fields.description: A heritage preservation initiative dedicated to restoring authentic wooden Mashrabiya lattices in historic houses of Old Cairo, reviving Islamic architecture, and supporting master craftsmen.
fields.story:
Historic Cairo is a global treasure trove of Islamic architecture, world-famous for its intricate wooden Mashrabiya windows that historically adorned ancient alleyways and heritage homes. Today, many of these architectural masterpieces face severe decay due to environmental factors, aging timber, and a critical lack of specialized restoration funding.

The "Restore the Mashrabiya of Historic Cairo" project aims to rescue these endangered elements. By partnering with skilled master carpenters and heritage conservationists, we meticulously repair, treat, and reinstall authentic Mashrabiya panels using traditional woodworking techniques. This initiative not only protects Egypt's priceless architectural identity but also trains local artisans to keep ancient crafts alive.

Your generous contribution directly funds quality timber, conservation materials, and expert craftsmanship. Join us in safeguarding the majestic architectural heritage of Historic Cairo for generations to come!

fields.title: Nile Cleanup Fleet: Cairo Chapter
fields.description: Deploying specialized cleanup boats and community volunteers to remove plastic waste, clear floating debris, and protect marine ecosystems along the Nile River in Cairo.
fields.story:
The Nile River is the lifeblood of Egypt, but sections flowing through Cairo face mounting environmental threats from plastic pollution, discarded packaging, and floating debris. This pollution endangers aquatic life, degrades water quality, and harms the natural beauty of Egypt’s most iconic waterway.

The "Nile Cleanup Fleet: Cairo Chapter" initiative tackles this challenge head-on by deploying active cleanup vessels and mobilizing passionate local volunteers. Our teams systematically collect plastic waste from the river surface, sort recyclables, and organize riverside clean-up drives to raise public awareness about marine conservation and sustainable waste management.

Your support will directly fund boat maintenance, safety gear for volunteers, waste collection tools, and proper recycling operations. Join us in keeping the Nile clean, blue, and thriving for future generations!

fields.title: A Public Library for Mansoura Kids
fields.description: Building an interactive, well-stocked public library and reading space in Mansoura to inspire a love for reading, provide educational resources, and support learning for children and youth.
fields.story:
Education and early literacy are the foundation of a bright future, yet many children in Mansoura lack access to community libraries, diverse children's books, and quiet, inspiring study spaces outside of school hours.

The "A Public Library for Mansoura Kids" project aims to bridge this gap by creating a vibrant, child-friendly public library equipped with an extensive collection of books, storytelling corners, educational games, and basic digital learning tools. This space will host weekly reading sessions, literacy workshops, and creative activities designed to spark curiosity and nurture imagination among young minds.

Your contribution will directly help fund bookshelf installations, diverse book purchases, comfortable reading furniture, and educational materials. Join us in building a safe haven of knowledge and inspiration for the children of Mansoura!

fields.title: Future Stars: Empowering Underprivileged Youth Through Football
fields.description: A community-driven football academy in Egypt dedicated to discovering, training, and empowering talented underprivileged children, providing them with professional coaching, gear, and a clear pathway to a better future.
fields.story:
Egypt is full of raw football talent, but thousands of kids never get the chance to develop their skills due to a lack of financial resources and proper facilities. The "Future Stars Football Academy" is built to bridge this gap.

Our mission is to provide free, high-quality football coaching to 200 underprivileged boys and girls aged 8 to 15. But we are not just teaching them how to play; we are keeping them off the streets, teaching them teamwork, discipline, and healthy habits.

Why we need your support:
The funds raised will be directly invested into:

1.  Renting professional training pitches for a full year.

2.  Purchasing essential training equipment (balls, cones, bibs, agility ladders).

3. Providing complete kits and football boots for every child.

4. Covering the salaries of certified grassroots coaches.

5. Organizing local tournaments and inviting scouts from professional clubs.

By donating to this campaign, you are not just buying a football; you are investing in a child's dream. Join us in building the next generation of Egyptian football stars!
